transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, the usage-based billing meter has passed its sandbox integration tests, and we're targeting next month's billing cycle for launch. The current draft on the table proposes an immediate broad launch, two-decimal half-up rounding, 90 days of raw usage-event retention, and no mandatory invoice-preview review. As part of my normal signoff process, I need to check in with billing engineering, finance operations, privacy, and customer support before I make the final call. I'd like to hear any concerns or input you all have on this plan before I approve anything.

The current draft's two-decimal half-up rounding would not be sufficient for those contracts, and this finding hasn't yet been added to the launch checklist.
